Several important on-page SEO problems emerged from my review of your website. On the homepage, both the meta title and description are too long; it also contains multiple H1 tags and an improper heading structure, while many images lack ALT attributes. Addressing these findings should improve the website's SEO performance, crawlability, and search visibility.

The current figures—around 145 monthly visits and an Authority Score of 27—show that the website receives very low organic traffic and has low authority, leaving significant room for improvement. We can raise organic traffic and search rankings with the right SEO strategy, quality link building, and on-page optimization.

Several growth opportunities for your business stand out. Search-engine visibility is currently being restricted by the website's limited keyword rankings, weak backlink profile, and low organic traffic.

The brand also has little to no presence on emerging AI search and answer platforms, including ChatGPT, Google AI Mode, AI Overviews, Gemini, Claude, and Perplexity, where millions of users now discover and evaluate businesses.
